scripts.typecheck: bun -e "import { syncCssModuleTypes } from '@hewel/zgui-build'; await syncCssModuleTypes({ project: 'apps/shell/tsconfig.json', include: ['plugins/*/src'] });" && bun --bun run tsrs --project tsconfig.quickjs.json && bun --bun run tsrs --project packages/composer/tsconfig.json && bun --bun run tsrs --project apps/shell/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:rust: cargo test --workspace && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && cargo doc --workspace --no-deps
scripts.test:ui: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun test --timeout=30000 packages/sdk/tests/motion.test.ts packages/sdk/tests/zgui.test.ts apps/shell/tests/ plugins/
scripts.test:ts: cargo build --bins && bun test --timeout=30000 packages/ plugins/ apps/
scripts.check: cargo fmt --check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test:rust && bun run test:ts
